_readme: Species to keep OUT of the opponent pool, beyond what the CP rules already filter.
The generator decides league membership by max CP (level 50, 15/15/15):
No CP rule gets every judgement right, so this file is the override. Add a
species id to a league array to drop it as an opponent in that league only,
or to "all" to drop it everywhere. Ids are PvPoke speciesIds, the same ones
Exclusions only affect who appears as an OPPONENT. Every species stays
selectable as your own Pokemon regardless.
Re-run `npm run data` after editing. The generator reports how many were
dropped and warns about ids that match nothing, so typos surface.
